propositions: User identity differs between Cloud (accountId) and Data Center (name), requiring a protocol contract to unify assignee resolution across both deployments
PR #120's DC implementation returns authoritative=False unconditionally via unreachable getattr-based resolver, causing permanent assignee diff churn

A UserIdentityModel protocol with AccountIdIdentity (Cloud) and NameIdentity (DC) implementations must enforce that DC performs real lookup against user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True for resolvable assignees
NameIdentity must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently return non-authoritative values for unresolvable assignees
The identity model implementations must receive resolver as explicit constructor parameter, not discovered via getattr, eliminating unreachable branches
